description: This file defines classes and functions related to subgraph management and autotuning within the PyTorch Inductor compiler backend. It includes the SubgraphChoiceCaller class for benchmarking and selecting optimal subgraphs, and the SubgraphTemplate class for generating and managing subgraph options for autotuning, especially focusing on custom decompositions and layout consistency.

classes.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller
classes.description: Represents a subgraph autotuning choice, which compiles a GraphModule for benchmarking and evaluation. It manages example inputs, symbolically infers input shapes, caches decompositions, compiles for benchmarking, and provides benchmarking methods.

classes.name: SubgraphTemplate
classes.description: A template class used for creating subgraphs for autotuning. It generates SubgraphChoiceCaller instances based on provided FX graphs, manages multiple custom decomposition choices, and ensures layout consistency among variants.

methods.name: Any inline_subgraph_to_ir_nodes( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, inputs: list[Any], name: str )
methods.description: Converts a subgraph represented by a GraphModule into IR nodes, enabling fusing and epilogue fusion during codegen.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a subgraph choice caller with example inputs and prepares the FX graph for benchmarking.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller._compute_sym_input_values
methods.description: Extracts concrete symbolic input values from example inputs for runtime dispatch and autotuning.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.cache_decomposition
methods.description: Stores decomposition functions for range-based dispatch in autotuning.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.__str__
methods.description: String representation of the subgraph choice caller.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller._compile_for_benchmarking
methods.description: Compiles the FX graph into a module optimized for benchmarking.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.benchmark
methods.description: Benchmarks the compiled module with given inputs, using profiling if enabled.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.benchmark_collective
methods.description: Runs a single benchmark call for collective benchmarking, typically used in synchronized environments.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.hash_key
methods.description: Generates a hash key for caching and identifying this particular subgraph choice based on input sizes and graph.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.output_node
methods.description: Returns the IR node representing the output of this subgraph for codegen purposes.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.info_dict
methods.description: Provides metadata about this subgraph choice, used for logging or debugging.

methods.name: SubgraphChoiceCaller.autoheuristic_id
methods.description: Provides an ID for autoheuristic purposes, based on the subgraph name.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a subgraph template with a given name, used to generate subgraph choices.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate.generate
methods.description: Creates a SubgraphChoiceCaller instance based on a given FX graph and layout, for autotuning.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate.generate_custom_op_choices
methods.description: Generates multiple subgraph choices for custom operations based on provided decompositions and layout validation.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate._generate_variant_name
methods.description: Creates a descriptive string for a specific decomposition variant with its parameters.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate._validate_non_tensor_kwargs
methods.description: Checks that the kwargs dictionary contains only non-tensor parameters.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate._validate_layout_equivalence
methods.description: Ensures all provided layouts have consistent stride, device, dtype, and size to allow fair comparison.

methods.name: SubgraphTemplate._infer_custom_op_layout
methods.description: Infers output layout for custom ops using a default implementation, by creating dummy tensors within fake mode.
